name: SS - Video Story
description: Immersive parallax video storytelling section where video stays fixed as editorial content panels scroll over it. Features sticky video with fade-in text chapters, floating stat counters, glassmorphism content cards, custom overlay gradients, Ken Burns poster fallback, ambient glow, and scroll-triggered chapter reveals. Supports Shopify hosted video, YouTube/Vimeo, and MP4 URLs. Ideal for brand stories, product launches, and campaign pages. 70+ customization options.
